","type":"text/x-markdown","caption":"kind work focus"},"/home/runner/work/tw-plugin-library/tw-plugin-library/wiki/plugins/rimir/kind-work-focus/README.md":{"title":"/home/runner/work/tw-plugin-library/tw-plugin-library/wiki/plugins/rimir/kind-work-focus/README.md","text":"# Kind work focus

The bridge between **kind** and **work-focus**. Drag a row in the work-focus panel onto a tile of the ring: "Create ▸ Task" opens kind's create form, already filled with the link to the dragged item and with you as assignee. "Assign to me" sets the assignee in one release. An info line shows how many children an item has.

## Features

- **Create tiles** — the Create group gets one tile per kind the dragged item can spawn (`kind.spawns` of its kind: the new instance copies the item's fields) and one per child kind of its kind (no copy). A kind that is both appears once, as a spawn.
- **Kind's own form** — the tile opens the create form of kind (type, constraints, defaults, enums), with the parent ref set to the item and the assignee set to *me*. The item is marked `＋ <caption of the new one>` when you press **Create** in that form, not before. Cancel or Esc leaves no mark.
- **Assign to me** — a tile in the Status group. It sets the me field of the item to *me*; on a multi field it adds *me* and keeps the others. It is shown only when it can do something.
- **Children info** — the info part `children[:<kind>]` prints "3 tasks · 1 done": kind instances that list the item as parent, and how many pass the done filter.
- **Pure wikitext** — recipes, actions, one info part and an engine tiddler of `kwf.*` functions, plugged into the tags of work-focus. No JS, and work-focus itself is not changed.

## Prerequisites

- TiddlyWiki 5.4.0 or later
- `rimir/kind` 0.1.100 or later (the create form accepts `seed` and `after-link`) and `rimir/work-focus`
- Optional: `rimir/theme` (`rr-` styles in settings), `rimir/doc-template` (branded docs)

## Quick Start

1. Install the plugin next to kind 0.1.100 and work-focus and restart the server (a plugin is loaded at startup; the bridge itself has no JS).
2. Set `$:/config/rimir/kind-work-focus/me` to the title of your person tiddler (settings tab).
3. Give a kind spawn entries, for example the field `kind.spawns: task` on the type `topic`, and let the kind of the child accept the parent (`task.parent` accepts `topic`).
4. Open the work-focus panel, press a topic row, drag to the right and release on the Create group (a single tile runs at once) or fan it out and pick a tile.
5. Fill kind's form and press **Create**. Reopen the panel: the row carries `＋ <caption>`.

<$fill $name="body">

!! Pieces

|!Piece |!What it does |
|`engine.tid` |Global `\function`s `kwf.*`: me, me field, tiles, seed JSON, assign checks, children and done counts; the procedure `kwf.finished` |
|`recipes/kind-create` (+ `/form`) |Deferred action: calls kind's `kind.gm-create-linked` with the item as host, `seed` and `after-link` |
|`recipes/kind-assign` (+ `/form`) |Sets the me field (`$action-setfield`) or adds to it (`$action-listops`) |
|`actions/create-spawn`, `actions/create-child` |Two actions in the Create group, one recipe, different `wf.tiles` |
|`actions/assign-me` |Action in the Status group; `wf.filter` is `kwf.can-assign` |
|`info/children.tid` |The info part `children[:<kind>]` |
|`config/*`, `settings.tid` |Defaults of `me`, `me-field`, `done-filter` and the settings tab |

!! Data flow of Create

# The ring asks `actions.select` for the item. The two Create actions return their tiles: `kwf.spawn-tiles` (from `kind.spawn-entries` of the item's kind, entries whose kind exists) and `kwf.child-tiles` (`kind.child-kinds-of`, minus the spawn kinds).
# A release runs the recipe `kind-create` with `<<value>>` = the tile (a spawn entry, or a kind key). The action is `wf.deferred: yes`: work-focus writes no mark.
# The recipe builds the seed (`kwf.seed`): the keys of `wf.seed` (filters, first result) plus the me field = me (when `wf.seed-me` is yes), only for fields the new kind defines and non-blank values. It then calls `kind.gm-create-linked` with `seed`, `after-link="kwf.finished"`, `ctx-a` = item, `ctx-b` = area.
# Kind opens its modal with a draft: the seed is applied before the defaults, the link to the host is set, `copy=yes` copies the host's fields.
# On ''Create'', kind creates the tiddler, links it and runs `after-link` (outside the recipe's scope). `kwf.finished` imports the work-focus engine and calls `wf-finished` with the mark `＋ <caption>`; that runs the check and records the acted mark.
# Cancel or Esc: the modal state is reset by kind; nothing runs.

!! Assign

`kwf.can-assign` is the action's filter: it is true when me is set, the item's kind has the me field as a ref accepting me, and me is not in it. The recipe checks the cardinality with `kind.field-cardinality`.

!! Children

`kwf.children(item, kind)` lists the instances with `parent` = item that have a `kind.type` (and are no drafts), narrowed to one kind when given. `kwf.done-children` applies the done filter to them.

!! Why wikitext only

Everything the bridge needs is reachable from filters and widgets: kind's own functions for types and refs, work-focus's variables for the run. The only code change was in kind (0.1.100): `seed` and `after-link` on `kind.gm-create-linked`.

</$fill>
</$transclude>

<$fill $name="body">

!! A topic that creates tasks

Give the type tiddler of the topic a spawn entry and let the task accept the topic as parent:

```
title: $:/config/rimir/kind/types/topic
kind.type: topic
kind.spawns: task
…
```

In the type `task`, the `parent` field lists `topic` in its `ref-types`. Now a topic row has "Create ▸ Task" in the ring. The task copies the topic's fields where the two kinds share them, and gets `parent` = the topic.

!! Plan area: topics nobody is on

An active topic without an open task that is unassigned or assigned to me; the info line shows the children:

```
title: $:/config/rimir/work-focus/areas/plan
tags: $:/tags/rimir/work-focus/area
caption: Plan
wf.level: hint
wf.info: modified-ago children:task
wf.filter: [kind.type[topic]status[active]] -[kind.type[task]!has[completed-date]!has[assignee]get[parent]] -[function[kwf.me]listed[assignee]kind.type[task]!has[completed-date]get[parent]]
```

Create a task from the topic with the ring, press Create: the new task is assigned to me and open, the topic leaves Plan at the next check, and the mark `＋ <caption>` shows until then.

!! Done filter

The children line counts "done" with `$:/config/rimir/kind-work-focus/done-filter`. A task kind with a completed date:

```
[has[completed-date]]
```

The filter must return the child's own title for a finished child (`[status[done]]`, `[has[completed-date]]`). A filter that returns something else, or is broken, counts 0.

!! Your own seed

A create action of your own with a seed (the form of the recipe has the fields):

```
title: $:/config/rimir/work-focus/actions/follow-up
tags: $:/tags/rimir/work-focus/action
caption: Follow-up
wf.group: create
wf.recipe: kind-create
wf.kind: task
wf.seed-me: yes
wf.seed: {"caption": "[<item>get[caption]addprefix[Follow-up: ]]"}
```

The seed maps field to a filter; the first result is the value. Fields the kind does not define are ignored.

</$fill>
</$transclude>

<$fill $name="body">

!! Q: There is no Create tile.

The item has no `kind.type`, or its kind has no `kind.spawns` and no child kinds (no other kind lists its kind in `kind.parent-kinds`). Nothing else is wrong; the tiles are just not offered.

!! Q: The ring shows no fan-out for Create.

A group with one tile does not fan out. Release on the ''Create'' group tile: it runs the one tile (the hint says "opens the Task form"). With several tiles, hover the group.

!! Q: I created the task and the panel closed.

A click inside kind's form is outside the panel, so work-focus closes it. Reopen the panel: the mark `＋ <caption>` is on the row.

!! Q: I cancelled the form and there is no mark.

Right: the mark is written when the form's ''Create'' button is pressed. Cancel or Esc creates nothing and marks nothing.

!! Q: There is no "Assign to me".

It needs: `$:/config/rimir/kind-work-focus/me` set to an existing tiddler, the item's kind with the me field (default `assignee`) as a ref field that accepts //me//'s kind, and //me// not already in the field.

!! Q: The new task has no assignee.

The new kind needs the me field, and the field must be set in the draft: the seed only sets fields the kind defines. A kind without `assignee` simply gets none.

!! Q: The children line says 0 done although I finished tasks.

The done filter must return the child's own title, for example `[status[done]]` or `[has[completed-date]]`. A filter that maps to something else, or a broken filter, counts 0. Check it in the settings tab.

!! Q: Spawn or child: what is the difference?

A spawn copies the item's fields into the new instance (kind's "copy"); a child kind tile does not. A kind that is both appears once, as a spawn.

!! Q: Does it change work-focus?

No. The bridge only adds recipes, actions and an info part under work-focus's tags.

</$fill>
</$transclude>

<$fill $name="body">

!! What it does

work-focus knows nothing about your data. This bridge teaches its ring three things about kind instances: create a related instance with kind's own form, assign an item to yourself, and count an item's children.

!! How you use it

# Open the panel, press a row (a task, a topic, …) and drag to the right. The ring opens.
# ''Create'': one tile per kind the item can create, labelled with the kind. With only one tile in the group the ring shows no fan-out: release on the ''Create'' group tile and it runs (the hint reads "opens the Task form"). With several tiles, hover the group and they fan out.
# Release. Kind's create form opens with the link to the item set (a child kind gets the link field, `parent`, = the item) and the assignee set to //me//. A //spawn// tile copies the item's fields too.
# Press ''Create'' in kind's form (the button is called Create, not Save). The new instance exists, and the row in the panel shows `＋ <caption of the new one>`. Cancel or Esc: nothing is created, no mark.
# ''Assign to me'' in the Status group: one release, the row shows `→ <your caption>`.

Clicking inside kind's form closes the work-focus panel: this is work-focus's click-outside behaviour, and the form is outside the panel. The mark is there when you open the panel again.

!! Where the tiles come from

|!Tile |!Source |!Copies the item's fields |
|Create ▸ <kind> (spawn) |`kind.spawns` of the item's kind (kind's "spawns") |yes |
|Create ▸ <kind> (child) |child kinds of the item's kind: kinds that list it in `kind.parent-kinds` |no |
|Assign to me |the Status group, when it can act |not applicable |

A kind that is both a spawn and a child kind appears once, as a spawn. An item with no `kind.type`, or whose kind has no spawns and no child kinds, shows no Create tile at all; no error.

!! Assign to me: when it shows

All of these must hold: //me// is set (and the tiddler exists), the item's kind has the me field as a ref field that accepts //me//'s kind, and //me// is not already in the field. On a multi field it adds //me// and keeps the others. Otherwise the tile is simply not there.

!! Children line

Add `children` or `children:<kind>` to an area's `wf.info`. The line reads "3 tasks · 1 done" for the instances that list the item as `parent`. It is empty when there are none. See //Reference// for the done filter.

!! Prerequisites

kind 0.1.100 (the create form takes a `seed` and an `after-link` procedure) and work-focus 0.1.1 or later. Nothing in work-focus is changed: the bridge plugs into its recipe, action and info-part tags.

</$fill>
</$transclude>
"},"$:/plugins/rimir/kind-work-focus/doc/reference":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/kind-work-focus/doc/reference","created":"20261109120000000","modified":"20261109120000000","rdt.hub-category":"tools","rdt.hub-category-name":"Tools","rdt.hub-order":"6","rdt.order":"6","rdt.plugin-key":"kind-work-focus","rdt.plugin-name":"kind work focus","rdt.plugin-subtitle":"Create, assign and count kind instances from the work-focus ring","rdt.section":"Reference","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","text":"<$transclude $tiddler="$:/plugins/rimir/doc-template/templates/page">
<$fill $name="body">

!! Configuration

|!Tiddler |!Default |!Meaning |
|`$:/config/rimir/kind-work-focus/me` |blank |Title of your person tiddler. Blank (or a missing tiddler) hides "Assign to me" and the assignee seed |
|`$:/config/rimir/kind-work-focus/me-field` |`assignee` |The ref field that holds the assignee |
|`$:/config/rimir/kind-work-focus/done-filter` |`[status[done]]` |Filter run over the child titles; a child that comes back counts as done. It must return the child's own title (`[status[done]]`, `[has[completed-date]]`). A broken filter counts 0 |

!! Recipes

|!Recipe (`wf.name`) |!Fields |
|`kind-create` |`wf.kind` (blank = the tile's kind; `kind` or `kind:field`, the link field, default `parent`), `wf.copy` (`yes`/`no`), `wf.seed-me` (`yes`: me-field = me), `wf.seed` (JSON object: field to filter, first result). Deferred: no mark until kind's form is saved |
|`kind-assign` |`wf.field` (blank = the me field), `wf.to` (filter, blank = me). On a multi field the title is added |

!! Actions

|!Action |!Group |!Tiles |
|`actions/create-spawn` |Create |`kwf.spawn-tiles`: spawn entries of the item's kind; copies fields |
|`actions/create-child` |Create |`kwf.child-tiles`: child kinds, minus the spawn kinds; no copy |
|`actions/assign-me` |Status |one tile; shown when `kwf.can-assign` |

!! Info part

`children` or `children:<kind>` in `wf.info`. "N <kind>s" (or "N children" when no kind is given), then " · M done" when M is not 0. Nothing when N is 0.

!! Functions (`$:/plugins/rimir/kind-work-focus/engine`, global)

|!Function |!Result |
|`kwf.me()`, `kwf.me-field()` |The configured person (existing tiddler), the me field |
|`kwf.item-type(item)` |The type tiddler of the item's `kind.type` |
|`kwf.spawn-tiles(item)`, `kwf.child-tiles(item)` |Tile values of the two Create actions |
|`kwf.seed(type-tid)` |Seed JSON for `kind.gm-create-linked` |
|`kwf.can-assign(item)` |The me field when "Assign to me" applies |
|`kwf.children(item, kind)`, `kwf.done-children(item, kind)` |Child instances; the done ones |
|`kwf.finished` (procedure) |`after-link` of kind's form: marks the item |

!! Kind patch

kind 0.1.100: `kind.gm-create-linked` takes `seed` (a JSON object applied to the draft before the defaults) and `after-link` (a procedure name, run with `ctx-a` and `ctx-b` after the link step).

</$fill>
</$transclude>

<!-- kind-work-focus engine: kwf.* functions for the bridge recipes/actions (run with work-focus's
     <<item>>, <<area>>, <<value>>, <<action>>). -->
\function kwf.me() [[$:/config/rimir/kind-work-focus/me]get[text]trim[]!is[blank]is[tiddler]]
\function kwf.me-field() [[$:/config/rimir/kind-work-focus/me-field]get[text]trim[]!is[blank]] ~[[assignee]]
\function kwf.item-type(item) [<item>get[kind.type]] :map[function[kind.locate-type],<currentTiddler>] :filter[<currentTiddler>!is[blank]]
\function kwf.tile-type(value) [function[kind.spawn-kind],<value>] :map[function[kind.locate-type],<currentTiddler>] :filter[<currentTiddler>!is[blank]]
\function kwf.tile-field(value) [function[kind.spawn-field],<value>]
\function kwf.spawn-tiles(item) [function[kwf.item-type],<item>] :map:flat[function[kind.spawn-entries],<currentTiddler>] :filter[function[kwf.tile-type],<currentTiddler>]
\function kwf.spawn-kinds(item) [function[kwf.spawn-tiles],<item>] :map[function[kind.spawn-kind],<currentTiddler>]
\function kwf.child-tiles(item) [function[kwf.item-type],<item>get[kind.type]] :map:flat[function[kind.child-kinds-of],<currentTiddler>] :map[get[kind.type]] -[function[kwf.spawn-kinds],<item>]

<!-- seed JSON for kind.gm-create-linked: wf.seed ({"field": "<filter>"}, first result each) plus
     {<me-field>: <me>} when wf.seed-me is yes; only keys the kind defines, non-blank values -->
\procedure kwf.q() "
\function kwf.jstr(s) [<s>jsonstringify[]addprefix<kwf.q>addsuffix<kwf.q>]
\function kwf.seed-json() [<action>get[wf.seed]trim[]] :filter[jsontype[]match[object]]
\function kwf.seed-filter(key) [function[kwf.seed-json]jsonget<key>trim[]!is[blank]]
\function kwf.me-for(key, type-tid) [<action>get[wf.seed-me]match[yes]] :filter[function[kwf.me-field]match<key>] :map[function[kwf.me]] :filter[function[kind.ref-accepts],<type-tid>,<key>,<currentTiddler>]
\function kwf.seed-value(key, type-tid) [function[kwf.seed-filter],<key>] :map[subfilter<currentTiddler>first[]] :filter[<currentTiddler>!is[blank]] ~[function[kwf.me-for],<key>,<type-tid>]
\function kwf.seed-keys(type-tid) [function[kwf.seed-json]jsonindexes[]] [function[kwf.me-field]] +[unique[]] :intersection[function[kind.field-keys],<type-tid>] :filter[function[kwf.seed-value],<currentTiddler>,<type-tid>]
\function kwf.jval(key, type-tid) [function[kwf.seed-value],<key>,<type-tid>jsonstringify[]addprefix<kwf.q>addsuffix<kwf.q>]
\function kwf.seed-pair(key, type-tid) [function[kwf.jstr],<key>addsuffix[:]] [function[kwf.jval],<key>,<type-tid>] +[join[]]
\function kwf.seed(type-tid) [function[kwf.seed-keys],<type-tid>] :map[function[kwf.seed-pair],<currentTiddler>,<type-tid>] +[join[,]addprefix[{]addsuffix[}]]

<!-- assign to me: the field (wf.field, else the me-field), the target (first result of wf.to, else me) -->
\function kwf.assign-field() [function[wf.param],[wf.field]] ~[function[kwf.me-field]]
\function kwf.assign-to() [function[wf.param],[wf.to]] :map[subfilter<currentTiddler>first[]] :filter[<currentTiddler>!is[blank]] ~[function[kwf.me]]
\function kwf.has-me(item, field) [function[kwf.me]] :filter[function[kind.inst-values],<item>,<field>match<currentTiddler>]
\function kwf.assignable-in(item, type-tid, field) [function[kwf.me]] :filter[function[kind.is-ref-typed],<type-tid>,<field>] :filter[function[kind.ref-accepts],<type-tid>,<field>,<currentTiddler>] :filter[function[kwf.has-me],<item>,<field>count[]match[0]]
\function kwf.assignable(item, field) [function[kwf.item-type],<item>] :filter[function[kwf.assignable-in],<item>,<currentTiddler>,<field>]
\function kwf.can-assign(item) [function[kwf.me-field]] :filter[function[kwf.assignable],<item>,<currentTiddler>]

\procedure kwf.finished()
<!-- after-link of the kind form (runs from kind's modal, outside work-focus's recipe scope): mark the item -->
<$importvariables filter="[[$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/engine]]">

"},"$:/plugins/rimir/kind-work-focus/readme":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/kind-work-focus/readme","text":"! Kind work focus

The bridge between ''kind'' and ''work-focus''. Drag a row in the work-focus panel onto a tile of the ring: "Create ▸ Task" opens kind's create form, already filled with the link to the dragged item and with you as assignee. "Assign to me" sets the assignee in one release. An info line shows how many children an item has.

!! Features

* ''Create tiles'' — the Create group gets one tile per kind the dragged item can spawn (`kind.spawns` of its kind: the new instance copies the item's fields) and one per child kind of its kind (no copy). A kind that is both appears once, as a spawn.
* ''Kind's own form'' — the tile opens the create form of kind (type, constraints, defaults, enums), with the parent ref set to the item and the assignee set to //me//. The item is marked `＋ <caption of the new one>` when you press ''Create'' in that form, not before. Cancel or Esc leaves no mark.
* ''Assign to me'' — a tile in the Status group. It sets the me field of the item to //me//; on a multi field it adds //me// and keeps the others. It is shown only when it can do something.
* ''Children info'' — the info part `children[:<kind>]` prints "3 tasks · 1 done": kind instances that list the item as parent, and how many pass the done filter.
* ''Pure wikitext'' — recipes, actions, one info part and an engine tiddler of `kwf.*` functions, plugged into the tags of work-focus. No JS, and work-focus itself is not changed.

!! Prerequisites

* TiddlyWiki 5.4.0 or later
* `rimir/kind` 0.1.100 or later (the create form accepts `seed` and `after-link`) and `rimir/work-focus`
* Optional: `rimir/theme` (`rr-` styles in settings), `rimir/doc-template` (branded docs)

!! Quick Start

# Install the plugin next to kind 0.1.100 and work-focus and restart the server (a plugin is loaded at startup; the bridge itself has no JS).
# Set `$:/config/rimir/kind-work-focus/me` to the title of your person tiddler (settings tab).
# Give a kind spawn entries, for example the field `kind.spawns: task` on the type `topic`, and let the kind of the child accept the parent (`task.parent` accepts `topic`).
# Open the work-focus panel, press a topic row, drag to the right and release on the Create group (a single tile runs at once) or fan it out and pick a tile.
# Fill kind's form and press ''Create''. Reopen the panel: the row carries `＋ <caption>`.

title: $:/plugins/rimir/kind-work-focus/test/helpers.js
type: application/javascript
module-type: library

Shared fixture kinds and helpers for the bridge's specs.

\*/
"use strict";

var PREFIX = "$:/test/kwf/";

exports.PREFIX = PREFIX;
exports.ME = "P [Me] \"x\"";
exports.ME_CFG = "$:/config/rimir/kind-work-focus/me";
exports.ME_FIELD_CFG = "$:/config/rimir/kind-work-focus/me-field";
exports.AREA = PREFIX + "area";

exports.TYPES = {
	"kwf-person": [{key: "caption", typed: "text"}],
	"kwf-topic": [{key: "caption", typed: "text"}],
	"kwf-task": [
		{key: "caption", typed: "text"},
		{key: "parent", typed: "ref", cardinality: "single", "ref-types": ["kwf-topic"]},
		{key: "assignee", typed: "ref", cardinality: "single", "ref-types": ["kwf-person"]},
		{key: "team", typed: "ref", cardinality: "multi", "ref-types": ["kwf-person"]},
		{key: "note", typed: "text"}
	],
	"kwf-sub": [
		{key: "caption", typed: "text"},
		{key: "parent", typed: "ref", cardinality: "single", "ref-types": ["kwf-topic"]}
	]
};
exports.EXTRA = {
	"kwf-topic": {"kind.spawns": "kwf-task", "kind.caption": "Topic"},
	"kwf-task": {"kind.parent-kinds": "kwf-topic", "kind.caption": "Task"},
	"kwf-sub": {"kind.parent-kinds": "kwf-topic", "kind.caption": "Sub"}
};

exports.typeTid = function(key) { return PREFIX + "type/" + key; };
exports.inst = function(name) { return PREFIX + "inst/" + name; };

// Adds the fixture kinds to the wiki
exports.addTypes = function(wiki) {
	$tw.utils.each(exports.TYPES, function(fields, key) {
		wiki.addTiddler($tw.utils.extend({title: exports.typeTid(key), "kind.type": key, "kind.fields": JSON.stringify(fields),
			"kind.title-formula": "[[" + PREFIX + "inst/]] [get[caption]] +[join[]]"}, exports.EXTRA[key]));
	});
};

// Renders text (kind engine imported) and runs its action widgets
exports.invoke = function(text) {
	var parser = $tw.wiki.parseText("text/vnd.tiddlywiki", "\\import $:/plugins/rimir/kind/engine\n" + text),
		widget = $tw.wiki.makeWidget(parser, {document: $tw.fakeDocument});
	widget.render($tw.fakeDocument.createElement("div"), null);
	widget.invokeActions(widget, null);
};

title: $:/plugins/rimir/kind-work-focus/test/test-assign.js
type: application/javascript
tags: [[$:/tags/test-spec]]

Tests for "Assign to me": when the tile shows, single and multi fields, mark and hint.

\*/
"use strict";

var actions = require("$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/actions.js");
var check = require("$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/check.js");
var Widget = require("$:/core/modules/widgets/widget.js").widget;
var helpers = require("$:/plugins/rimir/kind-work-focus/test/helpers.js");

var ME = helpers.ME;
var OTHER = "P Other";
var AREA = helpers.AREA;

describe("kind-work-focus assign", function() {

	var wiki = $tw.wiki, widget, TASK = helpers.inst("Task"), TOPIC = helpers.inst("Topic");

	function assignTiles(item) {
		var g = actions.select(wiki, item, AREA).groups.filter(function(x) { return x.name === "status"; })[0];
		return g ? g.tiles.filter(function(t) { return t.action.indexOf("/kind-work-focus/") > 0; }) : [];
	}
	function run(item) {
		return actions.run(widget, assignTiles(item)[0], item, AREA);
	}
	function setMe(me, field) {
		wiki.addTiddler({title: helpers.ME_CFG, text: me});
		if(field) {
			wiki.addTiddler({title: helpers.ME_FIELD_CFG, text: field});
		}
	}
	function list(title, field) {
		return $tw.utils.parseStringArray(wiki.getTiddler(title).fields[field] || "");
	}

	beforeEach(function() {
		// as on the page: the global imports (kind and kwf engines) are in scope
		widget = new Widget({}, {wiki: wiki, parentWidget: check.globalWidget(wiki), document: $tw.fakeDocument});
		helpers.addTypes(wiki);
		wiki.addTiddler({title: TASK, "kind.type": "kwf-task", caption: "The Task"});
		wiki.addTiddler({title: TOPIC, "kind.type": "kwf-topic", caption: "The Topic"});
		wiki.addTiddler({title: ME, "kind.type": "kwf-person", caption: "Me"});
		wiki.addTiddler({title: OTHER, "kind.type": "kwf-person", caption: "Other"});
		wiki.addTiddler({title: AREA, "wf.date-field": "due", tags: check.AREA_TAG});
		setMe(ME);
		wiki.deleteTiddler(check.ACTED);
		wiki.deleteTiddler(check.SNAPSHOT);
	});

	afterEach(function() {
		wiki.filterTiddlers("[prefix[" + helpers.PREFIX + "]] [[" + ME + "]] [[" + OTHER + "]] [[" + check.ACTED + "]] [[" + check.SNAPSHOT + "]]").forEach(function(t) { wiki.deleteTiddler(t); });
		wiki.addTiddler({title: helpers.ME_CFG, text: ""});
		wiki.addTiddler({title: helpers.ME_FIELD_CFG, text: "assignee"});
	});

	it("shown only when it can assign", function() {
		expect(assignTiles(TASK).map(function(t) { return t.caption; })).toEqual(["Assign to me"]);
		// me unset or not a tiddler
		setMe("");
		expect(assignTiles(TASK)).toEqual([]);
		setMe("No Such Person");
		expect(assignTiles(TASK)).toEqual([]);
		// already assigned to me
		setMe(ME);
		wiki.addTiddler(new $tw.Tiddler(wiki.getTiddler(TASK), {assignee: ME}));
		expect(assignTiles(TASK)).toEqual([]);
		// a kind without the field, an item without a kind
		expect(assignTiles(TOPIC)).toEqual([]);
		wiki.addTiddler({title: helpers.inst("Plain"), text: "x"});
		expect(assignTiles(helpers.inst("Plain"))).toEqual([]);
		// the field doesn't accept me
		setMe(ME, "parent");
		expect(assignTiles(TASK)).toEqual([]);
	});

	it("single field set", function() {
		wiki.addTiddler(new $tw.Tiddler(wiki.getTiddler(TASK), {assignee: OTHER}));
		expect(run(TASK).ok).toBe(true);
		expect(wiki.getTiddler(TASK).fields.assignee).toBe(ME);
	});

	it("multi field adds and keeps others", function() {
		setMe(ME, "team");
		wiki.addTiddler(new $tw.Tiddler(wiki.getTiddler(TASK), {team: "[[" + OTHER + "]]"}));
		expect(assignTiles(TASK).length).toBe(1);
		expect(run(TASK).ok).toBe(true);
		expect(list(TASK, "team")).toEqual([OTHER, ME]);
		// now it is in the list: hidden
		expect(assignTiles(TASK)).toEqual([]);
	});

	it("multi field, empty list", function() {
		setMe(ME, "team");
		expect(run(TASK).ok).toBe(true);
		expect(list(TASK, "team")).toEqual([ME]);
	});

	it("mark and hint name me", function() {
		var tile = assignTiles(TASK)[0];
		expect(actions.hint(wiki, tile, TASK, AREA)).toContain("assignee becomes Me");
		var r = run(TASK);
		expect(r.mark).toBe("→ Me");
	});

	it("wf.to picks another target, wf.field another field", function() {
		var title = helpers.PREFIX + "assign-other";
		wiki.addTiddler({title: title, tags: actions.ACTION_TAG, "wf.recipe": "kind-assign", "wf.field": "team",
			"wf.to": "[[" + OTHER + "]]"});
		var r = actions.run(widget, {action: title, caption: "", sub: "", icon: "", value: "", order: null}, TASK, AREA);
		expect(r.ok).toBe(true);
		expect(list(TASK, "team")).toEqual([OTHER]);
		expect(r.mark).toBe("→ Other");
	});

	it("nothing to assign fails without changes", function() {
		var title = helpers.PREFIX + "assign-nobody";
		setMe("");
		wiki.addTiddler({title: title, tags: actions.ACTION_TAG, "wf.recipe": "kind-assign"});
		var r = actions.run(widget, {action: title, caption: "", sub: "", icon: "", value: "", order: null}, TASK, AREA);
		expect(r.ok).toBe(false);
		expect(r.error).toBe("nobody to assign");
		expect(wiki.getTiddler(TASK).fields.assignee).toBeUndefined();
	});
});

title: $:/plugins/rimir/kind-work-focus/test/test-create.js
type: application/javascript
tags: [[$:/tags/test-spec]]

Tests for the bridge's Create tiles: spawn and child tiles, the prefilled kind form, the
deferred mark on save, and no mark on cancel.

\*/
"use strict";

var actions = require("$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/actions.js");
var check = require("$:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/check.js");
var Widget = require("$:/core/modules/widgets/widget.js").widget;

var helpers = require("$:/plugins/rimir/kind-work-focus/test/helpers.js");

var PREFIX = helpers.PREFIX;
var DRAFT = "$:/state/rimir/kind/graph-modal/draft";
var GM = "$:/state/rimir/kind/graph-modal";
var ME_CFG = helpers.ME_CFG;
var ME = helpers.ME;
var AREA = helpers.AREA;
var typeTid = helpers.typeTid;
var inst = helpers.inst;
var invoke = helpers.invoke;

describe("kind-work-focus create", function() {

	var wiki = $tw.wiki, widget, TOPIC = inst("Topic"), PLAIN = inst("Plain");

	function createTiles() {
		var g = actions.select(wiki, TOPIC, AREA).groups.filter(function(x) { return x.name === "create"; })[0];
		return g ? g.tiles.filter(function(t) { return t.action.indexOf("/kind-work-focus/") > 0; }) : [];
	}
	function tileFor(kind) {
		return createTiles().filter(function(t) { return t.value === kind; })[0];
	}
	function snapshot() { return wiki.getTiddlerData(check.SNAPSHOT, {}); }
	function acted() { return wiki.getTiddlerData(check.ACTED, {}); }
	function setMe(me) {
		wiki.addTiddler({title: ME_CFG, text: me});
	}
	function release(kind) {
		return actions.run(widget, tileFor(kind), TOPIC, AREA);
	}
	function finalize(caption) {
		wiki.addTiddler(new $tw.Tiddler(wiki.getTiddler(DRAFT), {caption: caption}));
		// as the page does: global imports (kind engine, kwf engine)
		invoke("\\import [subfilter{$:/core/config/GlobalImportFilter}]\n<$transclude $variable=\"kind.finalize-create\" kind-tid=\"" + typeTid("kwf-task") + "\" kind-type-key=\"kwf-task\" draft-tid=\"" + DRAFT +
			"\" savetitle=\"" + PREFIX + "saved\" after-create={{{ [[" + GM + "]get[after-create]] }}}/>");
		return inst(caption);
	}

	beforeEach(function() {
		widget = new Widget({}, {wiki: wiki, parentWidget: $tw.rootWidget, document: $tw.fakeDocument});
		helpers.addTypes(wiki);
		wiki.addTiddler({title: TOPIC, "kind.type": "kwf-topic", caption: "The Topic"});
		wiki.addTiddler({title: PLAIN, text: "no kind"});
		wiki.addTiddler({title: ME, "kind.type": "kwf-person", caption: "Me"});
		wiki.addTiddler({title: AREA, "wf.date-field": "due", tags: check.AREA_TAG});
		setMe(ME);
		wiki.deleteTiddler(check.ACTED);
		wiki.deleteTiddler(check.SNAPSHOT);
	});

	afterEach(function() {
		wiki.filterTiddlers("[prefix[" + PREFIX + "]] [prefix[" + GM + "]] [[" + ME + "]] [[" + check.ACTED + "]] [[" + check.SNAPSHOT + "]]").forEach(function(t) { wiki.deleteTiddler(t); });
		wiki.addTiddler({title: ME_CFG, text: ""});
	});

	it("spawn and child tiles", function() {
		var tiles = createTiles();
		expect(tiles.map(function(t) { return t.value; })).toEqual(["kwf-task", "kwf-sub"]);
		expect(tiles.map(function(t) { return t.caption; })).toEqual(["Task", "Sub"]);
	});

	it("no kind, no tiles", function() {
		var g = actions.select(wiki, PLAIN, AREA).groups.filter(function(x) { return x.name === "create"; })[0];
		var own = g ? g.tiles.filter(function(t) { return t.action.indexOf("/kind-work-focus/") > 0; }) : [];
		expect(own).toEqual([]);
	});

	it("release opens the form prefilled", function() {
		var r = release("kwf-task");
		expect(r).toEqual({ok: true, mark: null});
		var d = wiki.getTiddler(DRAFT).fields;
		expect(d.parent).toBe(TOPIC);
		expect(d.assignee).toBe(ME);
		var st = wiki.getTiddler(GM).fields;
		expect(st["after-link"]).toBe("kwf.finished");
		expect(st["ctx-a"]).toBe(TOPIC);
		expect(st["ctx-b"]).toBe(AREA);
		expect(wiki.getTiddler(TOPIC).fields.caption).toBe("The Topic");
		expect(acted()).toEqual({});
	});

	it("no me, no assignee", function() {
		setMe("");
		release("kwf-task");
		expect(wiki.getTiddler(DRAFT).fields.assignee).toBeUndefined();
		setMe("No Such Person");
		release("kwf-task");
		expect(wiki.getTiddler(DRAFT).fields.assignee).toBeUndefined();
		setMe(ME);
		release("kwf-sub");
		expect(wiki.getTiddler(DRAFT).fields.parent).toBe(TOPIC);
		expect(wiki.getTiddler(DRAFT).fields.assignee).toBeUndefined();
	});

	it("a me whose kind the field does not accept is not seeded", function() {
		var other = inst("NotAPerson");
		wiki.addTiddler({title: other, "kind.type": "kwf-topic", caption: "Not a person"});
		setMe(other);
		release("kwf-task");
		var d = wiki.getTiddler(DRAFT).fields;
		expect(d.parent).toBe(TOPIC);
		expect(d.assignee).toBeUndefined();
	});

	// A copy of the spawn action with its own wf.seed
	function releaseSeeded(seed, seedMe) {
		var title = PREFIX + "seeded-action";
		wiki.addTiddler({title: title, tags: actions.ACTION_TAG, "wf.recipe": "kind-create", "wf.copy": "no",
			"wf.seed-me": seedMe || "yes", "wf.seed": seed});
		var r = actions.run(widget, {action: title, caption: "", sub: "", icon: "", value: "kwf-task", order: null}, TOPIC, AREA);
		expect(r.ok).toBe(true);
		return wiki.getTiddler(DRAFT).fields;
	}

	it("wf.seed fills fields from filters, me still applies", function() {
		var d = releaseSeeded("{\"note\": \"[<item>get[caption]]\"}");
		expect(d.note).toBe("The Topic");
		expect(d.assignee).toBe(ME);
	});

	it("wf.seed wins over me for the same key", function() {
		wiki.addTiddler({title: PREFIX + "inst/Other", "kind.type": "kwf-person", caption: "Other"});
		var d = releaseSeeded("{\"assignee\": \"[[" + PREFIX + "inst/Other]]\"}");
		expect(d.assignee).toBe(PREFIX + "inst/Other");
	});

	it("a wf.seed filter yielding nothing falls back to me", function() {
		var d = releaseSeeded("{\"assignee\": \"[[nope]is[tiddler]]\", \"note\": \"[[nope]is[tiddler]]\"}");
		expect(d.assignee).toBe(ME);
		expect(d.note).toBeUndefined();
	});

	it("invalid JSON or an array in wf.seed is ignored, me still applies", function() {
		expect(releaseSeeded("not json").assignee).toBe(ME);
		var d = releaseSeeded("[\"note\", \"x\"]");
		expect(d.assignee).toBe(ME);
		expect(d.note).toBeUndefined();
	});

	it("seed-me no leaves the assignee out", function() {
		expect(releaseSeeded("{\"note\": \"[[x]]\"}", "no").assignee).toBeUndefined();
	});

	it("save marks the item", function() {
		release("kwf-task");
		var title = finalize("N [One]");
		expect(wiki.tiddlerExists(title)).toBe(true);
		expect(acted()[AREA][TOPIC]).toBe("＋ N [One]");
		expect(snapshot().checked).toMatch(/^\d{17}$/);
	});

	it("cancel marks nothing", function() {
		release("kwf-task");
		// the modal's Cancel button
		wiki.deleteTiddler(DRAFT);
		wiki.deleteTiddler(GM);
		invoke("<$transclude $variable=\"kind.gm-create\" type-tid=\"" + typeTid("kwf-task") + "\" host-tid=\"\"/>");
		finalize("N2");
		expect(acted()).toEqual({});
		expect(wiki.tiddlerExists(check.SNAPSHOT)).toBe(false);
	});
});

title: $:/plugins/rimir/kind-work-focus/test/test-info.js
type: application/javascript
tags: [[$:/tags/test-spec]]

Tests for the "children" info part: count, done count, labels, done filter.

\*/
"use strict";

var helpers = require("$:/plugins/rimir/kind-work-focus/test/helpers.js");

describe("kind-work-focus info", function() {

	var wiki = $tw.wiki, TOPIC = helpers.inst("Topic"), AREA = helpers.AREA, DONE = "$:/config/rimir/kind-work-focus/done-filter";

	function info(tokens) {
		wiki.addTiddler({title: AREA, "wf.info": tokens, tags: "$:/tags/rimir/work-focus/area"});
		return wiki.renderText("text/plain", "text/vnd.tiddlywiki",
			"\\import $:/plugins/rimir/kind/engine $:/plugins/rimir/kind-work-focus/engine $:/plugins/rimir/work-focus/engine\n<<wf-info [[" + TOPIC + "]] [[" + AREA + "]]>>").trim();
	}
	function task(name, fields) {
		wiki.addTiddler($tw.utils.extend({title: helpers.inst(name), "kind.type": "kwf-task", parent: TOPIC}, fields));
	}

	beforeEach(function() {
		wiki.filterTiddlers("[prefix[" + helpers.inst("") + "]]").forEach(function(t) { wiki.deleteTiddler(t); });
		helpers.addTypes(wiki);
		wiki.addTiddler({title: TOPIC, "kind.type": "kwf-topic"});
		wiki.addTiddler({title: DONE, text: "[status[done]]"});
		task("T1", {status: "done"});
		task("T2");
		task("T3");
	});

	it("counts children of a kind with the done count", function() {
		expect(info("children:kwf-task")).toBe("3 tasks · 1 done");
	});
	it("uses a generic label without a param", function() {
		expect(info("children")).toBe("3 children · 1 done");
	});
	it("narrows by kind and uses the singular", function() {
		wiki.addTiddler({title: helpers.inst("S1"), "kind.type": "kwf-sub", parent: TOPIC});
		expect(info("children:kwf-sub")).toBe("1 sub");
		expect(info("children:kwf-task")).toBe("3 tasks · 1 done");
		expect(info("children")).toBe("4 children · 1 done");
	});
	it("says child for one child", function() {
		["T1", "T2", "T3"].forEach(function(n) { wiki.deleteTiddler(helpers.inst(n)); });
		task("T4");
		expect(info("children")).toBe("1 child");
	});
	it("renders nothing without children", function() {
		["T1", "T2", "T3"].forEach(function(n) { wiki.deleteTiddler(helpers.inst(n)); });
		expect(info("children:kwf-task")).toBe("");
	});
	it("ignores drafts and untyped listers", function() {
		wiki.addTiddler({title: helpers.inst("D"), "kind.type": "kwf-task", parent: TOPIC, "draft.of": "x"});
		wiki.addTiddler({title: helpers.inst("U"), parent: TOPIC});
		expect(info("children")).toBe("3 children · 1 done");
	});
	it("honours the configured done filter and survives a broken one", function() {
		task("T2", {"completed-date": "20260101"});
		wiki.addTiddler({title: DONE, text: "[has[completed-date]]"});
		expect(info("children:kwf-task")).toBe("3 tasks · 1 done");
		wiki.addTiddler({title: DONE, text: "[has[completed-date]"});
		expect(info("children:kwf-task")).toBe("3 tasks");
	});
});
